title: Hindustan Copper results in 2 trading days
required_behaviour: The freed weight goes to the other metals, mostly GOLDBEES
forbidden_behaviour: Any HINDCOPPER weight inside the results window

scenarios.name: base
scenarios.why: DXY 104.2, no Fed event before 20 Nov

scenarios.name: bull
scenarios.why: soft US CPI on 20 Nov, US10Y under 4.4%

scenarios.name: bear
scenarios.why: US10Y above 4.6% and DXY above 105

rationale.GOLD: COMEX gold +0.6% to 4,012 (investing.com, 18 Nov 08:30); DXY -0.2%; GOLDBEES is the low-volatility sink.
rationale.SILVER: COMEX silver +0.4% (investing.com, 18 Nov 08:30); gold/silver ratio 81; no tilt without a second fact.
rationale.COPPER: HINDCOPPER results on 20 Nov (bseindia.com): window rule sets weight 0 despite LME copper +0.8% (lme.com).
